events.title: Navi Pillay awarded Peace Prize: 'Lifetime spent fighting for what's right & to uphold human rights'
events.description: Haxie Meyers-Belkin is pleased to welcome Rosa Freedman, Professor of Law Conflict and Global Development at the University of Reading. Navi Pillay's career represents a remarkable contribution to international law and human rights, from her pioneering role in post-apartheid South Africa to her work at the United Nations. Yet her legacy also raises difficult questions about political impartiality, particularly in relation to Israel and Gaza. She believes we need to distinguish between the significance of her lifelong achievements and the controversy surrounding the decision to award her the Nobel Peace Prize at this particular moment. More broadly, this debate invites us to examine whether the prize is recognising individual merit or increasingly serving as a vehicle for political messaging. At a time when international law and multilateral institutions face mounting pressure, and serious threats, Freedman asserts that the challenge is to scrutinise their shortcomings without undermining the principles they exist to uphold.
events.ticker_label: 🪖 Navi Pillay awarded Peace Prize: 'Lifetime spent fighting for what's right & to uphold human rights'

events.title: ‘Like a drill going into my eye’: why the mystery over Havana syndrome refuses to die
events.description: Dozens of CIA officers have been afflicted by debilitating symptoms over the past decade. Are they the result of ‘mass hysteria’? Or are they from attacks with an energy weapon and, if so, who is responsible? And has there been a cover-up? Shortly after 1am one night in April 2019, a CIA officer on a work trip to London was jolted awake in his hotel room by the most intense head pain he had ever experienced. His body was soaked with sweat and he felt like his eyes were spinning in their sockets. He manoeuvred his way out of bed, hoping to make it to the bathroom to vomit, but found his sense of balance had deserted him. Eventually, he fell back into a fitful, shallow sleep. The next day, arriving at the work meeting he had travelled for, the officer found he could not remember the names of colleagues in the room, people he knew well. As the meeting got under way, he could barely follow the discussion. Initially, he chalked it up to a terrible – if rather odd – case of food poisoning. But over subsequent weeks, worrying symptoms persisted: brain fog, loss of balance and increasingly harsh tinnitus. Continue reading...

events.description: Species with leaves large enough to be seen from space is already critically endangered – and plans are afoot to protect it A chance social media encounter has led to the race-against-time discovery of a new species of giant waterlily that has until now been hidden in the depths of Colombia’s jungle. But the plant, which is so huge it is visible from space, is already considered critically endangered. Continue reading...

events.title: Women with PMOS should get subsidised weight-loss drugs, Australian advocates say
events.description: With GLP-1s to treat the condition not specifically approved by the TGA, patients are being prescribed them off-label Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Women living with a chronic hormonal condition should have access to taxpayer-funded weight-loss medications, advocates say. The Polyendrocrine Metabolic Ovarian Syndrome Association of Australia (POSAA) is urging for GLP-1 drugs to be approved on the Pharmaceutical Benefits Scheme for people living with the condition. Continue reading...

events.title: Firmus pulls biggest ASX float since Telstra amid investor doubt about datacentre company
events.description: The $11-a-share offer would have been the biggest debut on the stock market since the telecommunication giant in 1997 Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Firmus Technologies has scrapped what was set to be Australia’s biggest company listing in decades after investor demand for its much-hyped AI datacentre business failed to materialise. A Firmus spokesperson said the board decided that proceeding with the offer was no longer in the best interests of the company and its shareholders. Continue reading...

events.title: Trump says U.S. to get diesel from Russia, relaxing pressure on Moscow to ease prices before midterms
events.description: Trump says the U.S. will obtain diesel from Russia, relaxing years of U.S. pressure on Moscow, to combat prices before midterms. He said he struck the deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin in a phone call.

events.title: New U.S. indictment charges former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro with torture
events.description: U.S. authorities added new torture charges to their case against former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro, ramping up pressure on the ousted authoritarian leader already fighting drug trafficking allegations.

events.title: Trump weighs livestream execution amid bipartisan backlash
events.description: Donald Trump said he hasn't decided whether the execution of the Fort Hood shooter will be livestreamed, after the Pentagon announced it would do so. The plan has been criticized by both Republicans and Democrats.
events.ticker_label: 🚨 Trump weighs livestream execution amid bipartisan backlash

events.title: China, EU reach deal to 'moderate' China's car exports to EU
events.description: An agreement between the EU and China would reduce exports of Chinese electric and plug-in hybrid cars to the 27-member European bloc by up to 50%, according to the EU trade envoy.

events.title: Macron and Steinmeier struggle to revive Franco-German ties
events.description: Presidents Frank-Walter Steinmeier and Emmanuel Macron are about to step down from their offices. Their meeting in France made it clear how urgently the Franco-German partnership needs new momentum.

events.title: Art for freedom: Maria Kalesnikava in Bonn
events.description: The Belarusian musician and civil rights activist Maria Kalesnikava held the keynote speech on the importance of art at the 2026 Beethovenfest in Bonn. She also visited DW.

events.title: 'All human emotions': French astronaut Sophie Adenot's first words since returning to Earth
events.description: French astronaut Sophie Adenot said she experienced “the full range of human emotions, from the most joyful to the most difficult” during her eight months in space, speaking on Saturday in Cologne, Germany, in her first public appearance since returning to Earth.

events.title: Three men found guilty of killing Australian brothers and their American friend
events.description: Three men have been found guilty of murdering two Australian brothers and their American friend during a surfing trip in Mexico.

events.title: Venezuela's Nicolas Maduro and wife face new charges
events.description: Former Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro and his wife Cilia Flores have been charged by US authorities with conspiracy to commit torture in a new superseding indictment.

events.title: Royal Navy serviceman accused of plotting to leak intelligence to Russia appears in court
events.description: A junior Royal Navy serviceman accused of plotting to leak classified information to Russia has appeared in court.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Royal Navy serviceman accused of plotting to leak intelligence to Russia appears in court

events.title: Ethiopia tells UN it is acting in self-defense against Eritrea
events.description: Ethiopia has told the United Nations Security Council it is taking self-defense measures against Eritrea

events.title: Jean Massillon, a Haitian mayor known for defending the people of Kenscoff, has died
events.description: Jean Massillon, the well-known mayor of Kenscoff, a once peaceful farming community in Haiti that has been under assault by violent gangs, has died
events.ticker_label: 💥 Jean Massillon, a Haitian mayor known for defending the people of Kenscoff, has died

events.title: Haiti police say US missionary detained following sex abuse allegations at orphanage
events.description: Haitian police tells The Associated Press that a U.S. missionary accused of running an illegal orphanage in Haiti has been detained following child abuse allegations

events.title: Thieves pull off Italy's biggest-ever wine heist, stealing 30,000 bottles worth 5 million euros
events.description: Thieves have stolen about 30,000 bottles of premium wine worth an estimated 5 million euros from a Marchesi Antinori winery in Tuscany in what the company says is the largest wine theft in Italy’s history

events.title: Australian bishop acknowledges 8-year delay in justice in Indigenous abuse case but defends process
events.description: A top Australian Catholic bishop has acknowledged the eight-year delay in bringing a fellow bishop to justice on charges he sexually abused young Indigenous men

events.title: UK's Labour wins a special election that puts Green Party leader under pressure
events.description: Britain’s Labour Party has won a special election in London, defeating the Green Party's leader

events.title: A US charity plans to use AI to monitor its Gaza classrooms for 'hateful' speech
events.description: A U.S. charity in Gaza is worried that teachers at its schools might stray from a curriculum it says promotes peace and tolerance
events.ticker_label: 💥 A US charity plans to use AI to monitor its Gaza classrooms for 'hateful' speech

events.title: UN rights chief: Legacy of slavery and colonialism is still fuelling racism
events.description: The legacy of enslavement and colonialism continues to shape the lives of Africans and people of African descent, UN human rights chief Volker Türk said on Thursday, calling for urgent action to deliver reparatory justice beyond financial compensation.

events.title: Texas think tank accuses Houston parent coalition of using 'socialist' tactics to push radical agenda
events.description: The Texas Public Policy Foundation accuses a Houston education coalition of using socialist-aligned tactics to push radical policies in HISD schools.

events.title: Fugitive Ryan Hanafin, wanted after mother found dead in kitchen, waives extradition
events.description: Ryan Hanafin waived extradition in a brief Vermont hearing, agreeing to return to Massachusetts after his mother Andria Hanafin was found shot dead.

events.title: Attorney for former Cornell fraternity member wants AG James off case over post supporting accuser
events.description: Letitia James posted "We stand with you" days before being named independent prosecutor in the Cornell University Chi Phi sexual assault case.

events.title: Charles Manson follower tied to Sharon Tate murders gets recommended for parole after 55 years in prison
events.description: Patricia Krenwinkel's third parole recommendation in four years sets up another potential clash with Gavin Newsom over the Manson Family killer's release.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Charles Manson follower tied to Sharon Tate murders gets recommended for parole after 55 years in prison

events.title: Former Massachusetts police officer faces murder trial over pregnant woman's staged suicide
events.description: Prosecutors say former Stoughton officer Matthew Farwell groomed Sandra Birchmore starting at age 15 and later strangled her over her pregnancy.

events.title: FIRST ON FOX: FBI targets Ghana scam compound linked to nearly $10M in losses, more than 130 detained
events.description: The FBI's Operation Blackout led to over 130 arrests in Ghana and nearly $10 million in fraud losses tied to scam compounds targeting American seniors.
events.ticker_label: 💥 FIRST ON FOX: FBI targets Ghana scam compound linked to nearly $10M in losses, more than 130 detained

events.title: Illinois woman disappears on trip with boyfriend who returned home without her, mother says
events.description: Alyssa Smith vanished after a Chicago trip with her boyfriend, who returned home without her, her mom said. Possible sightings near Grant Park are under review.

events.title: Who is Navi Pillay? Nobel Peace Prize winner's UN record renews fierce antisemitism accusations
events.description: Navi Pillay's 2026 Nobel Peace Prize sparked backlash from Jewish advocacy groups and UN Watch over allegations of anti-Israel bias and antisemitism.

events.title: Mike Waltz fights back tears revealing what Hamas hostage refused to do before release
events.description: Eliya Cohen, freed after 505 days in Hamas captivity, and Nova festival survivor Ziv Abud shared their harrowing stories at the United Nations.

events.title: Former German spy chief arrested on suspicion of espionage, attempted treason
events.description: August Hanning, 80, who led Germany's BND from 1998 to 2005, faces espionage and attempted treason charges tied to roughly 2,000 classified documents.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Former German spy chief arrested on suspicion of espionage, attempted treason

events.title: Alleged killing by Marine prompts US military to restrict off-base liberty in Okinawa
events.description: The U.S. military in Okinawa banned troops from leaving base after a Marine was arrested for allegedly killing a woman at a Naha hotel on Saturday.
